payload.core_mechanism_summary: Brute-force iteration over all contiguous subarrays (slices) to find sum closest to 180, minimizing absolute difference of two sector sums.
payload.rationale: The solution enumerates start and end indices via nested loops, testing each continuous slice. No backtracking state is maintained, but among given subtypes, 'search_backtracking' is the closest catch-all for exhaustive search without advanced pruning or specific structures.
